entries.sus.title: How was using Rinda?
entries.sus.intro: Tell us how easy Rinda was to use. Choose how much you agree with each sentence. You can skip any of them.
entries.sus.1: I think that I would like to use Rinda often.
entries.sus.2: I found Rinda more complicated than it needed to be.
entries.sus.3: I thought Rinda was easy to use.
entries.sus.4: I think that I would need help from a technical person to be able to use Rinda.
entries.sus.5: I found the different parts of Rinda worked well together.
entries.sus.6: I thought there were too many things in Rinda that did not fit together.
entries.sus.7: I imagine that most people would learn to use Rinda very quickly.
entries.sus.8: I found Rinda very awkward to use.
entries.sus.9: I felt very confident using Rinda.
entries.sus.10: I needed to learn a lot of things before I could get going with Rinda.
entries.sus.thanks: Thank you. Your answers help make Rinda better.
